items.title: United States
kv: Statutes, proposals, operator rules and issuer terms allocate controls and remedies. The SEC's 29 September complaint adds an alleged USD15 million WhatsApp-led crypto investment fraud and asset-freeze request, but it is not an adjudicated platform insolvency, issuer failure or recovery distribution. The normalized country record still lacks a complete observed stress table for stablecoin redemption, custodian or bank failure, chain outage, exchange insolvency, tokenized-entitlement divergence or continuous-clearing liquidity gaps.
A reserve rule, risk control, simulation or contractual remedy is not evidence that the system performed as intended during a real failure.

items.title: South Korea
kv: The H1 survey measured a maximum virtual-asset decline of 69 percent, large reductions in holdings, trading and deposits, and a 78 percent decline in exchange operating profit. It counted 234 exclusively listed assets, including 93 with market capitalization no greater than KRW 100 million. These are market and business-model stress indicators, not proof of settlement failure or customer-asset loss.
Price decline, thin liquidity, lower turnover, operating loss, insolvency, custody shortfall and failed final settlement are different events.

items.title: European Union

No reviewed primary source established a run, reserve shortfall, failed redemption, custody deficit, Pontes fail, Qivalis loss or bank tokenized-deposit failure.
A supervisory vulnerability or proposed power is not an observed loss, and bounded absence in public sources is not proof that no customer experienced loss.

kv: SPF reported about S$182.2 million of cryptocurrency lost in scams during 2025, about 20% of all scam losses; investment scams were 38.4% of cases involving cryptocurrency transactions. SPF separately reported more than S$22 million in cryptocurrency scam proceeds recovered in 2025 and a Crypto Tracing Team operational from March 2025.
Crypto as transfer method or lost asset does not mean a licensed DPT firm failed; frozen or recovered proceeds are not necessarily distributed to victims and do not supply a national recovery rate.

items.title: Brazil
kv: Resolution 520 supplies controls aimed at stress: cash and virtual-asset separation, proof-of-reserve methods, independent assurance, position histories, cyber controls, delisting and withdrawal procedures, non-algorithmic reserve requirements and foreign-custody safeguards. Resolution 589 will require verifiable reserve and staking totals in BCB submissions from 1 January 2027. Current Itaú, BTG and Nubank offerings create real custody and intermediary exposure, but product availability and marketing assurances do not establish customer-asset sufficiency under stress. The reviewed official sources do not provide a national cutoff-specific ledger of exchange failures, stablecoin runs, customer losses, insolvency claims or final distributions.
A preventive control or regulator's authority is not observed loss absorption, successful recovery or a government guarantee.

items.title: Argentina
kv: The rules address potential stress through segregation, public proof of reserves, custody/key controls, immutable transaction records, annual systems audit, continuity and backup, complaint handling, suspension and cancellation. The Galicia sequence is an observed regulatory correction: the bank disclosed a 27 April 2022 launch and the BCRA imposed the sector restriction on 5 May. It does not by itself disclose customer unwind, prices, transfers, losses or final custody disposition. The reviewed official bundle does not supply a national provider-failure, stablecoin-run, custody-shortfall or customer-loss series.
Required controls and risk warnings are not evidence that a firm survived stress or that customers recovered.

items.title: South Africa
kv: SARB judged crypto and stablecoin activity not currently systemic while monitoring growth, cross-border links and regulatory gaps. FSCA/FIC authorization, inspection, risk management, records and travel-rule controls are prospective safeguards. ZARU's AUP report reconciled the July snapshot above par but disclaimed any audit opinion, assurance conclusion or internal-control testing; management remained responsible for supply, circulation and reserve definitions. Absa describes hardware-protected authorization, deterministic key derivation and recoverability, but no public customer count, assets under custody, outage or recovery test was located. The reviewed bundle does not supply a national provider-failure, stablecoin-run, custody-shortfall or consumer-loss series.
A systemic-risk judgment, inspection, control or warning is not evidence of firm solvency, stress survival, quantified customer loss or recovery.

items.title: Ghana
kv: SEC's 22 July 2026 notice named Ultima Cryptocurrency Group among 23 entities it said were not licensed for capital-market activities and described law-enforcement coordination. The official 2024 virtual-asset risk assessment, posted in 2026, documents banks flagging crypto-linked transfers, filing suspicious-transaction reports, marking or closing accounts and referring cases to authorities; examples include a GH¢376,213.98 bitcoin-linked pending balance and a GH¢790,650 three-day deposit series attributed to phone and crypto trading. The assessment rates custody and stablecoins high risk and reports 82% total risk and 83% exposure for fiat-to-virtual, virtual-to-fiat and peer-to-peer activity. These are case and model outputs, not adjudicated loss or a current national exposure total. Sandbox disclosures separately warn of total or partial loss, cyberattack, key loss and potentially irreversible technology failures. No official national VASP-loss, stablecoin-run or recovery series was located.
A warning, risk disclosure, investigation or safeguard is not a final adjudication, quantified customer loss, recovered-asset amount or distribution.

items.title: Rwanda

cells.text: SEC's 22 July 2026 notice named Ultima Cryptocurrency Group among 23 entities it said were not licensed for capital-market activities and described law-enforcement coordination. The official 2024 virtual-asset risk assessment, posted in 2026, documents banks flagging crypto-linked transfers, filing suspicious-transaction reports, marking or closing accounts and referring cases to authorities; examples include a GH¢376,213.98 bitcoin-linked pending balance and a GH¢790,650 three-day deposit series attributed to phone and crypto trading. The assessment rates custody and stablecoins high risk and reports 82% total risk and 83% exposure for fiat-to-virtual, virtual-to-fiat and peer-to-peer activity. These are case and model outputs, not adjudicated loss or a current national exposure total. Sandbox disclosures separately warn of total or partial loss, cyberattack, key loss and potentially irreversible technology failures. No official national VASP-loss, stablecoin-run or recovery series was located.

cells.text: FIC's assessment records high virtual-asset financial-crime risk and unregulated access. The new law requires reporting of fraud, theft, complaints and remedies, transaction tracing, cyber controls, continuity and freeze compliance, but no public administrative series yet demonstrates those controls in operation. Access Bank Rwanda's AML page classifies cryptocurrency dealers among prohibited businesses, a bank-specific risk policy rather than national law. NBR reports D-SIB resolvability assessments and a crisis simulation for banks; the CBDC proof of concept identifies privacy, cyber, device, failed-transaction and lost-credential risks. No primary-source national virtual-asset failure, custody shortfall, bank-token incident, loss or recovery series was located.

catalog_context.title: Crypto around the world: many licenses, no proven cross-border use
catalog_context.answer: Across 22 jurisdictions, we found no verified cross-border payment route that depends on crypto from end to end. The token layer still settles through ordinary banks and national payment systems.
